# Offline human assets

Models and authored animation: Innerscene, using MakeHuman / MPFB CC0 assets.
Source pages explicitly dedicate the downloaded assets to CC0 1.0.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

DYNORA modifications: textures resized to 1K; matching Sam sit animation merged.
These are textured anatomical character meshes, not scans of real people or motion capture.
Source geometry, rig and skin weights are retained.

- sam: https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/walk-carrying-phone-sam-3d-person-animated-241a2abe
- maya: https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/walk-carrying-phone-maya-3d-person-animated-06ba936a
- researcher: https://www.innerscene.com/tools/library/3d-parts/laboratory-researcher-3d-person-healthcare-7a3ceb81
